words.text: Protego Maxima. Fianto Duri. Repello Inimicum!
words.speaker: McGonagall

words.text: Give me Harry Potter... and no one else need die tonight.
words.speaker: Voldemort

words.text: Harry Potter. The boy who lived... come to die.
words.speaker: Voldemort

words.text: That wand was never yours, Tom. It answers to me.
words.speaker: Harry
